name: AoT:Insertplaygroundgamehere
desc:
- Sandbox game, most if not all abilities are free to use. Locked abilities will also be free in the future

- It's okay to RK but please don't spawn-kill.
 - We're pro-suggestions. Feedback is always appreciated if it'll help improve gameplay. 
- Have fun and don't cause any trouble for other players. 
- This game is based off Attack on Titan. If you haven't seen it yet, now would be a good time to start.
